# CANDIDATE: VIX_CONTANGO_FILTER_FOR_PUTS

**Filed:** 2026-08-18  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that bearish put entries (BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON) have lower win rates when the VIX term structure is in contango (near-term VIX futures cheaper than longer-term), indicating complacency and lower fear priced into options. Filtering out entries during VIX contango should reduce losses on losing J days while preserving winners, thereby increasing edge_capture on OP-16 anchors.

## Mechanism

Add a pre-entry filter that checks VIX term structure: compute contango signal as (VIX3M - VIX) > 0 (backwardation) vs < 0 (contango). For BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setups, only allow entry when VIX is in backwardation (VIX3M > VIX) OR VIX > 20 (existing condition). Exit logic remains unchanged (chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, TP1 at +50%, runner). Uses existing VIX and VIX3M data streams; if unavailable, falls back to VIX > 20 alone.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20 disclosure #1)
2. **Sample bias:** Proposed filter uses VIX term structure data; sample size depends on availability of VIX3M history. Overfit risk if contango condition correlates with specific market regimes (e.g., low volatility periods) not present in J anchor days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed yet)
4. **Real-fills NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not validated with realistic simulator)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: filter may block all entries on a strong bearish day (e.g., 5/04) if VIX contango occurs, turning winner into zero. Max drawdown: could increase if filter causes missed winners during volatile regimes. Blow-up scenario: persistent contango in bear markets leads to chronic undertrading and opportunity cost.
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute concentration of edge_capture contribution.
